nodes.name: Gold Decision Gate.md
nodes.summary: Dev_graph gate node (GATE-002) defining the advisory Layer-3 checkpoint that composes the six-guard taxonomy outcomes a Gold DecisionPacket cites in its guard_refs; stays advisory in v0 while the blocking surface moves to the Runtime Admission Gate.
nodes.languageNotes: Ontology-governed dev_graph gate node with typed frontmatter (canonical_id GATE-002, blocking:false) and a Relationships section of wikilinks for Neo4j export.

nodes.name: Runtime Admission Gate.md
nodes.summary: Dev_graph gate node (GATE-003) documenting the blocking Layer-3 admission checkpoint that composes evaluated guards into a fail-closed ADMIT/HOLD/REJECT verdict over the runtime record (SCHEMA-012), enforced in engine.py evaluate() and the RuntimeDecisionRecord invariant.
nodes.languageNotes: Typed dev_graph gate node (blocking:true) grounded in code at src/gold/paper_runtime/engine.py with required-guard ordering and fail-closed invariant semantics.

nodes.name: Trade Validation Gate.md
nodes.summary: Dev_graph gate node (GATE-001) describing the blocking Risk Control checkpoint that validates every proposed trade before broker submission via GuardrailEngine.validate() as a short-circuit conjunction of hard-limit predicates.
nodes.languageNotes: Typed dev_graph gate node (blocking:true) realized by guardrail_engine.py (FILE-001); aggregates five predicates into an approve/block decision at the trade boundary.
